celebration.name_latin: Ss. Andreas Dung-Lac, presbyter, et socii, martyres

summary_en: By decree of 1 June 1989, by mandate of John Paul II, the celebration of the Vietnamese martyrs Sts Andrew Dung-Lac, priest, and companions (canonized 19 June 1988) is inserted into the General Roman Calendar on 24 November each year as an obligatory memorial, to be inscribed in all Ordines and in future liturgical books.
excerpt:
Instante quidem Episcoporum Coetu Vietnamensi, litteris die 12 aprilis 1989 datis, ut celebratio Sanctorum Martyrum Vietnamensium Andreae Dung-Lac, presbyteri et sociorum, Calendario Romano generali inscriberetur, Summus Pontifex IOANNES PAULUS II eandem celebrationem in Calendarium Romanum inseri decrevit, statuens ut memoria Sanctorum Martyrum Vietnamensium quotannis die 24 novembris gradu memoriae obligatoriae ab omnibus peragatur.
Nova igitur memoria cunctis Ordinibus pro Missae et Liturgiae Horarum celebratione erit inscribenda atque eius indicatio ponetur in libris liturgicis cura Conferentiarum Episcoporum in posterum edendis.

summary_en: In the introduction to the updated General Roman Calendar (1969-1989) the Congregation states that, although the Normae universales (n. 5) provide for solemnities falling on a Sunday of Advent, Lent or Easter to be anticipated to the Saturday, it considers it preferable to move the solemnities of St Joseph and of the Annunciation to the following Monday when they fall on a Sunday of Lent, provided it is not Holy Week, so as to allow a complete celebration and avoid uncertainty about the Saturday evening Mass; an unsigned editorial note with no protocol or date, followed by a table of occurrences for 1990-2008.
excerpt: Cependant, pour permettre une célébration complète de la solennité de Saint Joseph et de celle de l'Annonciation, et pour éviter toute incertitude sur la messe à célébrer le samedi soir, la Congrégation pour le Culte Divin et la Discipline des Sacrements estime préférable de renvoyer ces deux solennités au lendemain lundi, pourvu que ce ne soit pas pendant la Semaine Sainte.

excerpt: Regiensis in Aemilia-Guastallensis, 20 sepmtembris 1989 (Prot. CD 493/89): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio celebratio Ss. Andreae Dung-Lac et sociorum, martyrum, a die 24 novembris ad diem 26 eiusdem mensis transferri possit.

summary_en: A line under the heading Calendaria particularia for the diocese of La Spezia-Sarzana-Brugnato (Italy); the page prints only the diocese, date and protocol number with no text of the act (the same protocol on p. 817 confirms the Italian text of the Proper of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours), presumably approval of the proper calendar (recorded as such by ruling).
excerpt: Spediensis-Sarzanensis-Brugnatensis, 20 iulii 1989 (Prot. CD 384/89).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Iosepha Naval Girbés, virgo

summary_en: Blessed Josefa Naval Girbés, virgin, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the archdiocese of Valencia (Spain), on 6 November each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Valentina, 25 iulii 1989 (Prot. 1445/88): conceditur ut in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat celebratio Beatae Iosephae Naval Girbés, virginis, quotannis die 6 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Congregatio Passionis Iesu Christi, Provinciae Americae Septemtrionalis

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Paulus a Cruce, presbyter ac fundator

summary_en: In the proper calendar of the North American provinces of the Passionists, and of the monasteries and institutes of the Passionist family in those provinces, the celebration of St Paul of the Cross, priest and founder, may be transferred from 19 to 20 October.
excerpt: Congregatio Passionis Iesu Christi, Provinciae Americae Septemtrionalis, 12 septembris 1989 (Prot. CD 490/89): conceditur ut in Calendario proprio earundem Provinciarum necnon Monasteriorum Religiosarum et Institutorum Familiae Passionistae in iisdem Provinciis celebratio Sancti Pauli a Cruce, presbyteri ac fundatoris, a die 19 octobris ad diem 20 octobris transferri possit.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum Praedicatorum (Collegium Apostolicum Patrum Paenitentiariorum Basilicae Sanctae Mariae Maioris in Urbe)

summary_en: The Dominican penitentiaries of the Basilica of St Mary Major in Rome may celebrate each year St Pius V, pope, on 30 April as a feast (Mass and Liturgy of the Hours) and the anniversary of the Dedication of the Basilica on 5 August as a solemnity, with the texts approved for the canons of the Basilica; a concession to a single community.

target.institute: Ordo Fratrum S. Augustini - Ordo Augustinianorum Recollectorum - Ordo Augustiniensium Discalceatorum

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Maria Magdalena a Nagasaki, virgo et martyr

summary_en: St Mary Magdalene of Nagasaki, virgin and martyr, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the Augustinians, Augustinian Recollects and Discalced Augustinians, on 20 October each year as a memorial (the same protocol also confirms her Mass and Office texts, pp. 819-820).
excerpt: Ordo Fratrum S. Augustini - Ordo Augustinianorum Recollectorum - Ordo Augustiniensium Discalceatorum, 26 iunii 1989 (Prot. CD 303/89): conceditur ut celebratio Sanctae Magdalenae a Nagasaki, virginis et martyris, in Calendario proprio inseri valeat, quotannis die 20 octobris gradu memoriae peragenda.

target.institute: Societas S. Francisci Salesii

celebration.name_latin: Beati Aloisius Versiglia, episcopus, et Callistus Caravario, presbyter, martyres

summary_en: The Salesians may transfer the memorial of the Blessed martyrs Luigi Versiglia, bishop, and Callisto Caravario, priest, inscribed in their proper calendar on 25 February, to 13 November.
excerpt: Societas S. Francisci Salesii, 27 iulii 1989 (Prot. CD 386/89): conceditur ut memoria Beatorum Martyrum Alosii Versiglia, episcopi, et Callisti Caravario, presbyteri, in Calendario Proprio die 25 februarii inscripta, ad diem 13 novembris transferri possit.

target.institute: Confoederatio a S. Eustochia Monialium Clarissarum Siciliae

celebration.name_latin: Sancta Eustochia, virgo

summary_en: St Eustochia, virgin, may be celebrated on 20 January each year as a feast in the churches of the Confederation of Poor Clare nuns of Sicily named after her (the same protocol on p. 820 grants the Mass texts approved for Messina).
excerpt: Confoederatio a S. Eustochia Monialium Clarissarum Siciliae, 19 iulii 1989 (Prot. CD 335/89): conceditur ut celebratio Santae Eustochiae, virginis, in ecclesiis Confoederationis quotannis die 20 ianuarii gradu festi peragi valeat.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Valentinus de Berrio-Ochoa, episcopus et martyr

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Valentín de Berrio-Ochoa, bishop and martyr, as secondary patron before God of the diocese of Bilbao (Spain); no date is given on the page.
excerpt: Flaviobrigensis, 18 augusti 1989 (Prot. CD 90/89): confirmatur electio Sancti Valentini de Berrio-Ochoa, episcopi et martyris, Patroni secundarii apud Deum dioecesis Flaviobrigensis.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo sub titulo «Domina Nostra a Divina Providentia»

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title «Our Lady of Divine Providence» as patroness before God of the members of the Commissariat Corps of the Italian Army, for the Military Ordinariate in Italy; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Ordinariatus Militaris in Italia, 19 iulii 1989 (Prot. CD 356/89): confirmatur electio beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo «Domina Nostra a Divina Providentia» Patronae apud Deum addictorum Corpori Commissariatus Exercitus italici.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Laurentius, diaconus et martyr

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Lawrence, deacon and martyr, as patron before God of the members of the Administration Corps of the Italian Army, for the Military Ordinariate in Italy; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Die 20 iulii 1989 (Prot. CD 406/89): confirmatur electio Sancti Laurentii, diaconi et martyris, Patroni apud Deum addictorum Corpori Administrationis Exercitus Italici.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Marcus, evangelista

summary_en: Confirms the election of St Mark the Evangelist as patron before God of the members of the amphibious troops (Lagunari) in Italy, for the Military Ordinariate in Italy; a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Die 21 iulii 1989 (Prot. CD 407/89): confirmatur electio Sancti Marci evangelistae Patroni apud Deum addictorum Copiis amphibiis seu Corpori Lacunalium in Italia.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Iosephus Nascimbeni, presbyter

summary_en: Confirms the election of Blessed Giuseppe Nascimbeni, priest, as patron before God of the parish community of the Holy Family in the diocese of La Spezia-Sarzana-Brugnato (Italy); a patron of a single parish.
excerpt: Spediensis-Sarzanensis-Brugnatensis, 14 septembris 1989 (Prot. CD 482/89): confirmatur electio Beati Iosephi Nascimbeni, presbyteri, Patroni apud Deum communitatis paroecialis Sacrae Familiae.

target.institute: Magistrae Piae v.d. «Venerini»

celebration.name_latin: Beata Rosa Venerini, virgo

summary_en: Confirms the election of Blessed Rosa Venerini, virgin, as patroness before God of the schools of the Maestre Pie Venerini; the patron of an institute's schools rather than of a calendar.
excerpt: Magistrae Piae v.d. «Venerini», 29 augusti 1989 (Prot. 1605/88): confirmatur electio Beatae Rosae Venerini, virginis, Patronae apud Deum Scholarum Magistrarum Piarum.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Carolus a Sancto Andrea, presbyter

summary_en: Blessed Charles of St Andrew (Houben), priest, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the archdiocese of Dublin (Ireland), on 5 January each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Dublinensis, 15 novembris 1989 (Prot. CD 675/89): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Caroli a Sancto Andrea, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 ianuarii gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Rupertus Mayer, presbyter

summary_en: Blessed Rupert Mayer, priest, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the diocese of Eichstätt (Germany), on 5 November each year as an optional memorial. The diocese is printed «Eistettentis».
excerpt: Eistettentis, 15 novembris 1989 (Prot. CD 671/89): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Ruperti Mayer, presbyteri, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 novembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Nicolaus Stensen, episcopus

summary_en: Blessed Nicolaus Stensen (Niels Steensen), bishop, may be inserted into the proper calendar of the archdiocese of Florence (Italy), on 5 December each year as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Florentina, 10 octobris 1989 (Prot. CD 582/89): conceditur ut celebratio Beati Nicolai Stensen, episcopi, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 5 decembris gradu memoriae ad libitum peragenda.

target.institute: Congregatio Sororum a Caritate Sancti Vincentii de Paul

celebration.name_latin: Beata Francisca Anna a Virgine Perdolente, virgo

summary_en: Blessed Francisca Ana of the Sorrowful Virgin (Cirer Carbonell), virgin, may be inserted into the calendars of the Congregation of the Sisters of Charity of St Vincent de Paul and of the diocese of Mallorca (Spain), on 27 February each year as an optional memorial, and as a feast in Sencelles where her body is kept.
excerpt: Maioricensis, 28 novembris 1989 (Prot. CD 86/89): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Franciscae Annae a Virgine Perdolente, virginis, in Calendaria Congregationis Sororum a Caritate Sancti Vincentii de Paul et eiusdem dioecesis Maioricensis inseri valeat, quotannis die 27 februarii gradu memoriae ad libitum, gradu vero festi in loco v.d. «Sencelles» ubi corpus eiusdem Beatae religiose asservatur, peragenda.

target.institute: Confoederatio monialium ab adoratione perpetua SS.mi Sacramenti

summary_en: A line under the heading Calendaria particularia for the Confederation of nuns of the Perpetual Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament; the page prints only the institute, date and protocol number with no text of the act, presumably approval of the proper calendar (recorded as such by ruling).
excerpt: Confoederatio monialium ab adoratione perpetua SS.mi Sacramenti, 20 octobris 1989 (Prot. CD 606/89).

target.institute: Institutum sororum Sacrae Familiae a Nazareth

summary_en: The Sisters of the Holy Family of Nazareth may insert Blessed Mary of Jesus the Good Shepherd (Frances Siedliska), virgin and foundress, into their proper calendar on 21 November each year as a feast, the memorial of the Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary being transferred to 20 November (the same protocol also confirms her texts, p. 862).
excerpt: Institutum sororum Sacrae Familiae a Nazareth, 25 octobris 1989 (Prot. CD 422/89): conceditur ut celebratio Beatae Mariae a Iesu Bono Pastore, virginis ac fundatricis, in Calendarium proprium inseri valeat, quotannis die 21 novembris gradu festi peragenda, memoria in Praesentatione Beatae Mariae Virginis ad diem praecedentem 20 novembris translata.

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo in caelum Assumpta

summary_en: Confirms the election of the Blessed Virgin Mary Assumed into Heaven as patroness before God of the diocese of Bata (Equatorial Guinea).
excerpt: Bataënsis, 10 octobris 1989 (Prot. CD 472/89): confirmatur electio Beatae Mariae Virginis in caelum Assumptae Patronae apud Deum dioecesis Bataënsis.

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Angelus ab Acri, presbyter

summary_en: Confirms the election of Blessed Angelo of Acri, priest, as secondary patron before God of the town of Acri in the archdiocese of Cosenza-Bisignano (Italy); a patron of a single town.
excerpt: Cosentina-Bisinianensis, 16 novembris 1989 (Prot. CD 683/89): confirmatur electio Beati Angeli ab Acri, presbyteri, Patroni Secundarii apud Deum civitatis v.d. «Acri».

target.institute: «Société du Sacré Cœur»

summary_en: The list of official liturgical books received by the Congregation (Libri liturgici officiales) records a «Liturgical Calendar» (labelled PM, Proprium Missarum) of the Society of the Sacred Heart in English, French and Spanish, confirmed on 14 April 1988 (French edition 17 March 1988) under Prot. 888/87; this is a bibliographic notice of a book already confirmed, not the text of the decree, and whether it approves a proper calendar cannot be told from the page.
excerpt:
